description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from exile to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
